Quick clarifications on the rollout gating and a small schedule ask.

On gating: we talked about two signals — latency regressions (p95/p99) and error rate spikes. My recommendation is:
- Non-blocking: latency p95 degradations up to 15% relative to baseline -> throttle and monitor (stagger slowdowns).
- Blocking: sustained p99 regressions > 20% or error rate > 0.5% for > 5 minutes -> immediate rollback to previous stable variant.

If execs prefer a more conservative approach I can change thresholds, but this split gives us a clear automatic response and a manual escalation path.

Schedule ask: we should shift the canary start to Fri 7/2 10:00 AM PT (instead of Thu 7/1) so the SRE on-call overlap covers first two hours. That will push back the procurement close by 24 hours; Lauren, can you confirm that's acceptable with OptiSoft? Emily, flag if that creates any downstream constraint.

Also linking the HubSpot deal for context: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5142/RDW-3721

—Karthik
